about_the_game:
In SCP: Directive Nine, step into the boots of an elite team deployed into hostile, anomalous territories where reality twists and dangers lurk at every turn. Combining intense cooperative gameplay with tactical depth, your squad must rely on strategy, communication, and specialized tools to survive unpredictable threats. Face off against mind-bending entities, navigate environments warped by unknown forces, and uncover mysteries that challenge your understanding of reality itself.

In our game, anomalous utilities offer players intriguing new methods to interact with the world around them, blending unpredictability with strategic depth. These peculiar tools defy traditional logic, creating opportunities for unexpected solutions to puzzles and unique combat tactics like this bear you can use to revive teammates. Each anomalous item comes with its own set of mysterious rules, inviting players to experiment and discover unconventional ways to overcome challenges, significantly enhancing immersion and replayability.

Face off against bosses unlike anything you've seen before—massive entities that demand precise teamwork and strategic execution. Each boss battle delivers a distinct experience, pushing your squad's coordination and adaptability to the limit. With unpredictable attack patterns and unique abilities that will test even seasoned players, overcoming these monstrous adversaries grants rare rewards, deepening your journey into the unknown.

content_descriptors.notes:
Our game contains mature content that may not be suitable for all audiences:

Intense Violence and Gore: Includes realistic blood, dismemberment, and combat against undead creatures and other monstrosities.

Psychological Horror: Features disturbing scenarios, eerie environments, and unsettling audio-visual effects.

Drug and Alcohol Use: References to drug and alcohol use impacting characters' behavior used to enhance the player.

Dark Themes: Explores sensitive topics such as self-harm.

Please consider these elements if you are sensitive to such content.

short_description: In SCP: Directive Nine, you’re authorized to weaponize SCPs in a frantic 2–4 player co-op FPS. Gear up with anomalous utility, tackle challenging puzzles, and go toe-to-toe against otherworldly horrors.
